Responsibilities for the hardworking season
This section sets out the plain rules

Companion Animal Travel Desk

The purpose of this section is to guide desk staff in giving clear, kind, and consistent support to travelers with companion animals. Staff must review each care plan with attention to species, temperament, and comfort, and they must record only the details needed to arrange safe and practical travel. The desk should welcome concerns early, answer in direct language, and avoid any wording that could cause confusion or unnecessary worry.

When handling a booking, staff are to confirm that the animal's needs can be met within Aurelia Skyways standards and airport conditions. If a traveler is uncertain, the desk should explain the available options in simple terms and recommend the choice that best supports the animal's welfare. Care plans may differ from one animal to another, and staff must treat each case on its own merits without assuming that one approach fits all.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk must keep communication calm, respectful, and useful. Staff should speak with patience, note any special handling requirements, and pass relevant information to the next team without delay. If a request cannot be accepted, the reason must be stated plainly, along with the nearest safe alternative. No promise should be made unless the desk is sure it can be kept.

Any concern about safety, documentation, or animal comfort should be raised through the normal internal channel at once. The desk must also support travelers by offering concise guidance that is easy to follow before departure and at check-in. For any unresolved matter, contact the senior coordinator through the usual internal reporting route.
